# Forecasting Yield Accuracy Improvements

Date: 2025-07-13  
Attendees: Linnea Marqmoor, Fiora Velkbrook, Ysolde Fennford  

**Agenda:**  
- Review latest yield prediction models for grow towers  
- Analyze accuracy improvements from recent nutrient dosing updates  
- Plan next steps for model validation and deployment  

**Discussion:**  
Linnea presented results from the new yield forecasting model version 4.3, showing a 12.7% reduction in mean absolute error compared to version 4.1, bringing MAE down from 3.8 kg/m² to 3.3 kg/m². The improved nutrient dosing algorithm, integrated last month, contributed an estimated 7.5% of the accuracy gains. Fiora highlighted the need to test the model across different crop varieties, noting that performance for leafy greens improved by 15%, but vine crops showed only a 5% increase. Ysolde recommended expanding the data set by including sensor data from the new east-side grow tower in Riverside, which began operations last quarter.  

**Decisions:**  
- Deploy version 4.3 in pilot mode on two farm sites starting July 20  
- Prioritize data collection for vine crops to enhance model calibration  
- Begin integration of additional environmental sensors by August 5  

**Action Items:**  
- Linnea to coordinate pilot deployment and monitor initial outcomes  
- Fiora to lead data expansion efforts focusing on vine crop sensors  
- Ysolde to manage sensor integration project and report progress weekly
